_readme: Partial source-reviewed root/stun coverage. One successful application per cast to one target, not per damage tick or CC tag. Assumes the root/stun portion lands. Conditional empowered/stacked/stance effects and displacement-only CC are not credited. Delays, charges, repeats, immunity and actual target health progression remain unmodeled. Source drift is a hard failure, requiring review.

adele:RMB.name: Imperial Lash
adele:RMB.sourceText:
Adele unfurls her Sword in a straight line, dealing 40/55/70/85/100 (+80%) true damage to all Enemies it passes through.

If she hits an Enemy Hero or Monster, they are Rooted for 0.6s and Adele dashes to the furthest target hit.

adele:R.name: Queen’s Garden
adele:R.sourceText:
Adele performs a small leap, slamming her shield into the ground, summoning a large Thornbush at her location for 8s.

Vines attach to all Enemies within the central section, dealing 55/90/125 (+5%) physical damage. This Interrupts abilities, Roots Enemies for 0.5s, and pulls flying Enemies to the ground.

All Enemies inside the Thornbush are Slowed by 35/37.5/40% and take 4/7/10 true damage every 35u moved within it.

akeron:E.name: Web Lash
akeron:E.sourceText:
Akeron fires a web, stopping on the first Target hit and causing various effects depending on the Target's type.

Heroes or Units: Damages for 70/95/120/145/170 (+30%) magical damage and Roots for 1s, also creating a web field that Slows Enemies by 35%.

World: Lashes to it for up to 5s. While attached to terrain, Akeron can use abilities or leap to the ground, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+50%)(+30%) physical damage, Knocking Up, and Stunning Enemies for 1s.

Awakened: Root and Stun Duration increased to 1.25.

argus:Q.name: Dread Nova
argus:Q.sourceText:
Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy.

Upon landing it explodes, dealing 85/125/165/205/245 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

aurora:E.name: Hoarfrost
aurora:E.sourceText:
Aurora creates a ring of frost on the ground around her. Enemies that touch the ring take 70/110/150/190/230 (+50%) magical damage and are Rooted for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

The ring remains in the world for 2.5s.

aurora:R.name: Cryoseism
aurora:R.sourceText:
Aurora freezes an area, applying a 50% Slow to all Enemies for 1.5s. After 1.5s, the ice freezes, Stunning the target for 1s. After the Stun, the Target explodes dealing 200/300/400 (+70%) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies.

Enemies damaged by Cryoseism will be Slowed by 50% for 0.5s before exploding, dealing 60/90/120 (+20%) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies. Targets can only be slowed this way once per Cryoseism.

crunch:RMB.name: Forward Crunch
crunch:RMB.sourceText:
Dash forward, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+75%)(+45%) physical damage on contact and Stunning them for 0.25s.

Empowered: Dash an extended distance and pushes Enemy Heroes.

dekker:RMB.name: Stasis Bomb
dekker:RMB.sourceText:
Launch a bouncing bomb, dealing 70/95/120/145/170 (+45%) magical damage and Stunning Enemies hit in a small area for 0.9s.

Stun duration increases up to 1.6s based on distance (3500 units max).

gadget:E.name: Security Gate
gadget:E.sourceText:
Throw forward an electrical gate that lasts 2.5s, granting Allied Units that pass through it 50% decaying movement speed for 2.5s.

If an Enemy passes through, the gate deals 70/90/110/130/150 (+40%) magical damage and Roots them for 1s.

grux:Q.name: Smash 'n Grab
grux:Q.sourceText:
Grux raises his clubs in the air before smashing the ground, sending forth a shockwave that Pulls all Enemies in its path towards Grux, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+100%) physical damage and Stunning them for 0.75s.

Range increases based on Channel Duration.

grux:R.name: Warlord's Challenge
grux:R.sourceText:
Grux slams his clubs together, Stunning all nearby Enemy Heroes for 0.75s.

For the next 8/10/12s, Grux gains 30/60/90% Attack Speed and empowers his attacks against Enemy Heroes to repeatedly steal 3/4/5 (+1.5%) Physical Power on-hit, returning after 4s.

This abilities duration is extended by 0.5s on-hit when Grux attacks Enemy Heroes that are afflicted with Max Bloodlust stacks.

howitzer:E.name: Land Mine
howitzer:E.sourceText:
Lob a mine that will explode 2.5s after landing, dealing 90/125/160/195/230 (+50%) magical damage to all Enemies in the area and Knocking Back any Enemy Heroes (and Howitzer) caught in the blast. Enemy Heroes are additionally Stunned for 0.5s.

Explodes early upon reactivation.

khaimera:R.name: Cull
khaimera:R.sourceText:
After a brief channel, Khaimera slices all Enemies in front of him, Stunning them for 1.25s and dealing 200/400/600 (+200%)(+100%) physical damage over 6 hits. The final hit Slows by 25% for 1.25s.

Grants 20 Rage stacks for each Enemy Hero or Monster hit.

lt-belica:Q.name: Seismic Assault
lt-belica:Q.sourceText:
Slam the ground, sending forth a seismic wave that erupts after 0.5s, dealing 100/140/180/220/260 (+60%) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Knocking Up and Stunning them for 1s.

Innovation: Stun duration increases to 1.4s.

maco:RMB.name: Maco Sparkle!
maco:RMB.sourceText:
Maco throws a slow-moving gemstone that explodes at its max range, or when detonated early by reactivating the ability.

When the gemstone explodes, it deals 70/95/120/145/170 (+45%) magical damage and Stuns Enemies for 0.5s.

Stun Duration increases up to 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s, based on the distance it travels.

murdock:Q.name: Static Trap
murdock:Q.sourceText:
Place a trap that arms after a short delay, dealing 40/80/120/160/200 (+100%)(+120%) magical damage to any Enemy Hero that steps on it and Rooting them for 1.25s.

Traps last for 40/45/50/55/60s and up to 3/3/4/4/5 may be placed at one time.

Max Charges: 2.

narbash:RMB.name: Thunk
narbash:RMB.sourceText: Toss a drumstick that deals 95/140/185/230/275 (+85%)(+130%) magical damage in a tiny area of effect, Knocking Back and Stunning the Enemies hit for 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s.

rampage:Q.name: Boulder Throw
rampage:Q.sourceText:
Rip a boulder from the earth and carry it for up to 5s. Rampage can throw the boulder, dealing 100/135/170/205/240 (+60%)(+80%) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Stunning them for 1.2/1.25/1.3/1.35/1.4s. Shatters on contact with Enemy Heroes.

Behemoth: Throw the boulder instantly.

steel:RMB.name: Shield Bash
steel:RMB.sourceText:
Swipe forward with Steel's shield, dealing 35/65/95/125/155 (+50%) (+5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8% of the Target's maximum health) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Stunning them for 0.5s.

Deals 50/55/60/65/70 additional damage to Monsters.

steel:R.name: Shield Slam
steel:R.sourceText: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90%) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.

the-fey:R.name: Fly Trap
the-fey:R.sourceText:
Plant a magical seedling, awakening a giant fly trap that attaches itself to all nearby Enemy Heroes.

After a brief delay, it Pulls its victims inward, dealing 250/375/500 (+100%) magical damage and Stunning them for 1s.

zarus:Q.name: Barricade
zarus:Q.sourceText:
Unfold a shield for 1.5s, reducing incoming damage by 75%.

Upon recasting or after the duration, swing the shield dealing 54/70/86/102/118 (+90%) physical damage increased up to 135/175/215/255/295 (+225%) and Stunning targets hit for 0.75s.

zinx:Q.name: Ricochet
zinx:Q.sourceText:
Throw an electromagnetic disk dealing 65/90/115/140/165 (+40%) magical damage and Stunning for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

The disk can ricochet up to 5 times, dealing its damage again and Stunning each target for 50% of the original duration.

Will not ricochet to previously hit targets.
